lines.zh: 我们一群细胞朝同一个方向漂
lines.en: We, a crowd of cells, drift the same way.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，动起来像布在飘
lines.en: No bones in me; I move like drifting cloth.

lines.zh: 五只袜子排成队，穿过末地
lines.en: Five socks in a line cross the End.

lines.zh: 我游得很快，因为我几乎没有重量
lines.en: I swim fast because I hardly weigh anything.

lines.zh: 我的边角翻卷，像被风晾着
lines.en: My edges curl as if hung out to dry.

lines.zh: 水流穿过我，我从里面游过去
lines.en: The current passes through me; I swim through it.

lines.zh: 一只袜子从水面漂过，那不是袜子
lines.en: A sock floats past; it is not a sock.

lines.zh: 我们伸出细丝，一起划水
lines.en: We reach out threads and row together.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块末地石，布角擦过它
lines.en: I round an end stone; a corner of cloth grazes it.

lines.zh: 我只有几厘米长，走得却远
lines.en: Only centimeters long, yet I travel far.

lines.zh: 我的形状跟不上我的速度
lines.en: My shape cannot keep up with my speed.

lines.zh: 我们像一队小旗，在虚空上飘
lines.en: We drift over the void like a line of small flags.

lines.zh: 我往前挪，纤维一根根亮起来
lines.en: I move on, fiber by fiber lighting up.

lines.zh: 别追，你一伸手我就散开
lines.en: Do not chase; reach out and I scatter.

lines.zh: 我们排成一条线，绕着虚空漂。
lines.en: We line up and drift around the void.

lines.zh: 末地的风一吹，我们就偏了。
lines.en: An End breeze blows, and we all veer.

lines.zh: 我飘过一片紫色，颜色染上来。
lines.en: I drift through a purple haze that stains my edges.

lines.zh: 三只在前，两只在后，队形不乱。
lines.en: Three ahead, two behind; the formation holds.

lines.zh: 我挂在半空，像谁忘在这里的袜子
lines.en: I hang in the air, a sock someone forgot.

lines.zh: 我们安静地交换着养分
lines.en: We quietly trade nutrients among ourselves.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，也没有胃
lines.en: I have no mouth, and no stomach.

lines.zh: 我漂着，边缘慢慢卷了又开
lines.en: I drift; my edges curl and uncurl.

lines.zh: 细菌不需要睡觉，只需要水
lines.en: Bacteria need no sleep, only water.

lines.zh: 我的里面比外面更热闹
lines.en: I am busier inside than outside.

lines.zh: 虚空很静，静得能数清自己
lines.en: The void is so quiet I can count myself.

lines.zh: 我把自己叠成一只袜子的样子
lines.en: I fold myself into the shape of a sock.

lines.zh: 有光的时候，我显得有点透明
lines.en: In the light I look faintly transparent.

lines.zh: 我们一整天只做一件事：漂
lines.en: All day we do one thing: drift.

lines.zh: 我的同伴贴着我，我们不分彼此
lines.en: My kin press against me; we blur together.

lines.zh: 我尝了尝水，这里的水什么都没有
lines.en: I taste the water; there is nothing in it.

lines.zh: 一只末影人经过，没认出我
lines.en: An enderman passed and did not know me.

lines.zh: 我像被晾了三百年的布
lines.en: I am cloth left hanging for three hundred years.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看了很久，我叫袜子
lines.en: You stared a long time; I am called a sock.

lines.zh: 我不是鱼，也不是袜子，你猜吧
lines.en: Not a fish, not a sock; take a guess.

lines.zh: 你一只眼就能装下我们整群
lines.en: One of your eyes could swallow my whole colony.

lines.zh: 我飘到你面前，让你看清纤维
lines.en: I drift before you so you can see my fibers.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往上飘一寸
lines.en: You reach; I drift up an inch.

lines.zh: 你在找线头吗？我全身都是
lines.en: Looking for a loose thread? I am all thread.

lines.zh: 我闻起来像海水，也像旧布
lines.en: I smell of seawater, and of old cloth.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我大概被当成了笑话
lines.en: You laughed; I am probably the joke.

lines.zh: 别用夹子夹我，我们会断
lines.en: Not the tongs; we would come apart.

lines.zh: 我看你，用的是整片身体
lines.en: I look at you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 这一下带走了我一半
lines.en: That blow took half of me away.

lines.zh: 我们缩紧，把受伤的部分包起来
lines.en: We tighten and wrap the hurt part inside.

lines.zh: 一命很薄，像一层膜
lines.en: One heart is thin, like a membrane.

lines.zh: 你弄断了几根纤维，我记住了
lines.en: You broke some fibers; I remember it.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我们会散，散完再聚
lines.en: In pain we scatter, then gather again.

lines.zh: 我的血是水，流出来就没了
lines.en: My blood is water; spilled, it is gone.

lines.zh: 别打第二次，第一次已经很够了
lines.en: Not a second time; the first was plenty.

lines.zh: 我们往石头缝里退，越退越薄
lines.en: We retreat into stone, growing thinner.

lines.zh: 你伤的不是我，是我们
lines.en: You did not hurt me; you hurt us.

lines.zh: 受伤之后，我学会绕开你的手
lines.en: Hurt, I learned to avoid your hands.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑落在水里，我们全涌过去
lines.en: A crumb falls in the water; we all surge.

lines.zh: 我只有一命，可我还是想吃
lines.en: One heart only, and still I want to eat.

lines.zh: 细菌的饿，是整群一起饿
lines.en: When bacteria hunger, the whole colony hungers.

lines.zh: 你的饵上有糖吗？我们不挑
lines.en: Is there sugar on your bait? We are not picky.

lines.zh: 钩子太粗，我的身体太薄
lines.en: The hook is thick; my body is thin.

lines.zh: 我围着饵转，像布绕着钉子
lines.en: I circle the bait like cloth around a nail.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口，水里全是铁味
lines.en: I sip, and the water tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我们挤在钩边，谁都怕落后
lines.en: We crowd the hook, afraid to fall behind.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，连影子也像食物
lines.en: Hungry, even a shadow looks like food.

lines.zh: 你要钓我，得先把钩藏好
lines.en: To catch me, hide the hook better.

lines.zh: 你碰掉了我半边纤维
lines.en: You knocked off half my fibers.

lines.zh: 我太薄，你的手指穿过我
lines.en: I am so thin your finger passes through.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个面，里面朝外
lines.en: The bump turned me inside out.

lines.zh: 我只有一命，别用力
lines.en: One heart only; do not push hard.

lines.zh: 水一挤，我就贴在你手上
lines.en: The water squeezes me onto your hand.

lines.zh: 那一下让我散成了三份
lines.en: That knock split me into three.

lines.zh: 我们赶紧聚回来，慢一点就没了
lines.en: We gather back quickly, or we are gone.

lines.zh: 你袖子上的线头，和我很像
lines.en: The thread on your sleeve looks like me.

lines.zh: 我滑开时留下一道淡淡的痕
lines.en: I slide away, leaving a faint smear.

lines.zh: 别揉，我们会渗进你的皮
lines.en: Do not rub; we would seep into your skin.

lines.zh: 两群细菌靠近，边界先融了
lines.en: Two colonies near; our borders melt first.

lines.zh: 我们没有男女，只有交换
lines.en: We have no sexes, only exchange.

lines.zh: 我的纤维和它的纤维缠在一起
lines.en: My fibers tangle with its fibers.

lines.zh: 我们贴成一团，分不清谁是谁
lines.en: We press into one mass; no telling who is who.

lines.zh: 分裂比相爱简单，但我们照样做
lines.en: Dividing is easier than loving; we do both.

lines.zh: 它的颜色比我浅，我记住了
lines.en: Its color is paler than mine; I remember.

lines.zh: 一小时后，我们会有两支队伍
lines.en: In an hour we will be two little fleets.

lines.zh: 我们用整片身体拥抱，没有手
lines.en: We embrace with whole bodies; we have no hands.

lines.zh: 交配对我们就是一次长谈
lines.en: Mating, for us, is one long conversation.

lines.zh: 新的袜子正在我们的边上长出来
lines.en: A new sock is growing at our edge.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，我连手指都没有
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; I have no fingers.

lines.zh: 那块碎布和我很像，我绕着它
lines.en: That scrap looks like me; I circle it.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西压住我，我渗出来
lines.en: A fallen thing pins me; I seep out from under.

lines.zh: 我裹住一粒沙，又放开了
lines.en: I wrap a grain of sand, then let go.

lines.zh: 桶底很滑，我知道那是什么地方
lines.en: The bucket's bottom is slick; I know that place.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体推了一下瓶盖
lines.en: I push the cap with my whole body.

lines.zh: 有些东西会沉，我们只会上浮
lines.en: Some things sink; we only ever rise.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沾了末地石粉
lines.en: Your dropped thing is dusted with end stone.

lines.zh: 我们把它围起来，当作新家
lines.en: We surround it and call it home.

lines.zh: 拿不动，就慢慢把它盖住
lines.en: Cannot carry it, so I slowly cover it.

lines.zh: 水里有一点甜，我立刻转向
lines.en: A trace of sweetness; I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我们整群同时决定，几乎不分先后
lines.en: The whole colony decides at once, almost together.

lines.zh: 那根线入水的震动，我们全听见了
lines.en: We all felt the line enter the water.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最慢的那滴水
lines.en: I fix on the slowest drop of water.

lines.zh: 你在水边坐下，我们抬起了边角
lines.en: You sit by the water; our edges lift.

lines.zh: 目标很小，可我比它还小
lines.en: The target is small; I am smaller.

lines.zh: 我们朝同一个点收拢
lines.en: We close in on the same point.

lines.zh: 有血的味道，从很远的地方来
lines.en: A taste of blood, coming from far off.

lines.zh: 我先动，其他四只跟上来
lines.en: I move first; the other four follow.

lines.zh: 一片碎屑在沉，我们追着它下去
lines.en: A crumb sinks; we follow it down.

lines.zh: 我贴着钩子转，不碰到它
lines.en: I circle the hook without touching it.

lines.zh: 我们排成一条线，跟着那道影
lines.en: We line up and follow that shadow.

lines.zh: 我离你只有一格，你还没发现
lines.en: I am one block away and still unseen.

lines.zh: 每次你回头，我就慢一点
lines.en: Each time you turn, I slow down.

lines.zh: 我们在你的视野边缘徘徊
lines.en: We hover at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 那条线在收，我跟着收
lines.en: The line reels in; I reel with it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的领口，那里有毛
lines.en: I watch your collar; there is fuzz there.

lines.zh: 只要不动，你就会把我当布
lines.en: Stay still and you will take me for cloth.

lines.zh: 我们散开，又在你背后聚拢
lines.en: We scatter, then gather behind you.

lines.zh: 跟上你很简单，风替我推
lines.en: Keeping up is easy; the wind pushes me.

lines.zh: 我们扑上去，糊住你的眼睛
lines.en: We lunge and smear over your eyes.

lines.zh: 我咬不动，但我能钻进缝里
lines.en: I cannot bite, but I get into cracks.

lines.zh: 一命换你一次痒，值得
lines.en: One heart for one itch of yours; worth it.

lines.zh: 我们的边缘像刀，只是很钝
lines.en: Our edges are knives, only blunt ones.

lines.zh: 我贴住你的手背，开始渗
lines.en: I cling to your hand and start seeping.

lines.zh: 这一撞几乎没力气，但很黏
lines.en: The hit has little force, but much stick.

lines.zh: 你揉眼睛的时候，我们已经进去了
lines.en: While you rub your eye, we are already in.

lines.zh: 我们不为杀你，只为让你走开
lines.en: We do not want you dead, just gone.

lines.zh: 我散成雾，你又挥空了
lines.en: I burst into mist; you swing at nothing.

lines.zh: 攻击之后，我们会少一些
lines.en: After attacking, there will be fewer of us.

lines.zh: 我们在一滴水里成形，先有边
lines.en: We take shape in a drop, edges first.

lines.zh: 一只袜子落进末地，它开始动
lines.en: A sock lands in the End and starts to move.

lines.zh: 那天风很大，我们被吹成一团
lines.en: That day the wind blew us into one shape.

lines.zh: 我不是生下来的，我是长出来的
lines.en: I was not born; I grew.

lines.zh: 一开始只有几个细胞，后来是一群
lines.en: A few cells first, then a crowd.

lines.zh: 我们缠上第一根纤维，就再没散
lines.en: We caught our first fiber and never let go.

lines.zh: 虚空给了我们地方，也给了我们风
lines.en: The void gave us room, and gave us wind.

lines.zh: 三只同伴从旁边漂来，加入我们
lines.en: Three kin drifted over and joined us.

lines.zh: 我出生时像一块湿布，现在也像
lines.en: Born looking like wet cloth; still do.

lines.zh: 有人把我们误认成鱼，我们没纠正
lines.en: Someone mistook us for fish; we said nothing.

lines.zh: 火把我们烤成一小份熟鱼
lines.en: Fire bakes us into a small cooked fish.

lines.zh: 从末地高处掉下，我们贴在石上
lines.en: Dropped from high in the End, we splatter on stone.

lines.zh: 水里的细菌也会被水淹死
lines.en: Even water bacteria can drown in water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我们吹成一小片雾
lines.en: The blast blows us into a little mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我们，留下一个圆洞
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a round hole.

lines.zh: 魔法把我们一粒粒数清了
lines.en: Magic counts us out, cell by cell.

lines.zh: 饿到后来，我们开始吃自己
lines.en: Starving long enough, we begin eating ourselves.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我们全都变白
lines.en: Lightning flashes; every one of us goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空把最后一根纤维也收走了
lines.en: The void takes the last fiber of us.
